5.  **Root Cause Analysis:** Based on log analysis, identify the most probable cause (e.g., out-of-memory, disk full, kernel panic, application bug, malicious activity).

**UK & USA Tour - 2016**
Performed 8 shows across London (Barbican Centre), Birmingham (Symphony Hall), New York (Symphony Space), Chicago (Old Town School of Folk Music), and Toronto (Aga Khan Museum). Tour organized in collaboration with the Indian Council for Cultural Relations (ICCR).

Performed 4 concerts across Dubai (Dubai Opera - Foyer Stage) and Abu Dhabi (Cultural Foundation) as part of the UAE-India Year of Tolerance cultural exchange program.
